The west had a better record against the east last year for the 24th time in 27 years. Pretty insane stat. Who won the chip is largely irrelevant. Both conferences generally have at least a couple teams in the contender tier, but east vs west record usually indicates which conference is deeper, and that conference is pretty much always the west. Things will balance out a bit this season as we get a bigger sample size, but it seems like the west is once again the deeper conference despite preseason predictions
